description: A Flask web app that generates tailored CVs and cover letters using the Anthropic API. Built by Ana during her job search as a way to learn while solving a real problem.

phases.phase_1: Paste job description, get fit score out of 10 with reasoning, generate tailored CV and cover letter as PDF download
phases.phase_2: Automated job discovery — attempted LinkedIn and Indeed scraping, both blocked. Parked. Manual JD pasting is the core value.
phases.phase_3: One-click application pack with editable web interface before download
phases.phase_4: Application tracker — SQLite, status pipeline (Documents Generated, Applied, Interview Scheduled, Offer Received, Rejected, No Response), auto-logging, follow-up email generator

in_progress: ATS score panel — visual breakdown of how well the CV matches the job description
Review API key handling and ensure secrets are loaded from environment, not hardcoded
learnings: LinkedIn and Indeed block scraping — manual step is intentional product decision
Flask download_name parameter replaces deprecated attachment_filename
anthropic must be installed via --prefer-binary to avoid Rust/tokenizers compilation errors
The manual JD paste step creates deliberate friction — you only apply to roles you've chosen carefully
Consider using Anthropic's latest model identifiers and pinning a model version string in config to avoid breakage when default models are deprecated
Flask file downloads should use send_file with download_name; for larger PDF generation consider streaming responses to avoid memory spikes
SQLite is fine for single-user local tracking, but if deploying to a multi-user or hosted environment, plan a migration path to PostgreSQL since SQLite handles concurrent writes poorly
ReportLab PDF generation can be slow for complex layouts — consider caching generated documents keyed by job description hash to avoid regenerating identical packs
Store the Anthropic API key in environment variables (e.g. via python-dotenv) rather than in code, and handle rate-limit / 429 errors gracefully with retries and backoff
recent_decisions: Parked automated job discovery in favour of manual JD pasting
Added company name to CV download filename
Built follow-up email generator into the tracker
Flagged need to pin Anthropic model version and add error handling for API rate limits
